title: Text: DET Mikaela Higgins ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: This Baldwin dude gonna get fired
Really why
I'm hearing borderline sexual harassment, discrimination stuff
What were you talking about earlier
This guy is fucked up
How many ppl you talk to?
3 so far
Hoping they can get me more
Wow. Very interesting.  4 including your original email? Did he ever write back?
Proud of you👊
Be careful though.  This guy's smily and you dont want word getting out
I know
You're awesome. Love that you're doing this
What were you talking about earlier
I have someone else that might talk to you
Jeff Lutz called me into his office yesterday.  Said he wanted to talk to me about Ellen and me exiting the organization
He dove into some more Dave stuff. Said Chris Granger and Ilitch wanted our revenue,  ticket sales protections for the next 5 years.

Lutz did it and showed Dave for approval,  but Dave was pissed.. told him to raise it a few thousand dollars. Lutz said no, saying "that has no data to support it" these are the numbers the data set came up with based on the team getting better, weather, etc.

Dave got pissed and Lutz and freaked out at him.. raised it himself thousands of dollars and handed it in to Chris and Chris.. with no data to.back up the claims and with Lutz' name tied to the report

Talk to your girl Jillian.. she had an offer in LA for a Manager role at Rockstar Energy Drink. Took it. Put in her two weeks. Met with Dave the next day and what do you know.. he promised her a bunch of shit and she stayed
She hasn't messaged me back, we're done
Its okay. Shes on the Dave train
Ew
Cute nice and sweet, but naive and not very smart that one

Jillian is one of many who have tried to quit and Dave has convinced to stay... telling them theyd be moved into manager roles.. how many managers can a ticket dept have..? And no docs were signed, just lip service.  They're all just too dumb and hes too manipulative
The other day he said anyone over the age of 30 shouldn't work there
He's way too young to be in that role
Agreed. Hes in over his head and it shows.. example: the Lutz data set
Have you seen his glassdoor reviews? Might be a nice add in to your article
No
From ticket service reps in Miami.. theyre not good, put it that way lol
Oh my
Oh yes
